messages:
Kelly (CSM): Quick capture from two fintech onboardings today — wanted to dump notes here before EOD.
Raj (PM): ok thanks, can you bullet the asks?
Kelly (CSM): 1) per-account prompt templates (so each tenant can pin approved prompts) 2) clearer diffs/changelog when model variants update 3) much faster embedding refresh for small updates (they saw ~90s)
Ava (CS Ops): can you paste the exact phrasing customers used? helps the triage doc.
Kelly (CSM): verbatim: "need a way to lock prompts to our account so engineers don't accidentally change our brand tone" and "when we update a prompt, embeddings should reflect changes in <30s for small datasets"
Marcos (ProdOps): note: locked prompts => per-tenant storage + RBAC surface. infra cost scales with template count. Embedding <30s is on the indexing side (streaming upserts or push reindex).
Raj (PM): sounds like two product areas: prompt tenancy + embedding pipeline. changelog diffs is UI and a small diff engine.
Lina (Support): echo — we've got a ticket asking for model-change diffs. Customers call it "what changed in model behavior" and it causes anxiety on small teams.
Kelly (CSM): impact guess from my calls: prompt tenancy = high (enterprise procurement blocker); embedding refresh = medium (automation and UX issues); changelog diffs = low-medium (confidence/QA).
Ava (CS Ops): action: I'll create a triage page and tag cs-prio. Kelly — please drop customer names and account-level context.
feedback-bot: New triage page created by Ava (CS Ops) — https://notion.redwood/inbox/field-voice-1715270400 assigned to Raj (PM).
Kelly (CSM): accounts: FinOak and SablePay. SablePay said they'd pay for a small expedited pilot if we offered it.
Marcos (ProdOps): quick workaround idea: a small "staging push" API that forces immediate reindex for a tiny batch. Low-effort shim while we build streaming upsert.
Lina (Support): I'll draft a KB on the Notion triage with the workaround and curl examples.
Raj (PM): Marcos — can you give a ballpark effort (S,M,L) for each? If any are >2w we should propose enablement docs as temporary mitigation.
Marcos (ProdOps): ballpark: prompt tenancy + RBAC = Medium-High (DB + APIs + UI). Embedding <30s = High if we want robust SLA (new service). Changelog diffs = Low (mostly frontend + small backend diff).
Ava (CS Ops): noted. I've added a triage checklist and tags: onboarding-friction, renewal-risk, cs-prio.
Kelly (CSM): I've added short impact notes and pasted call quotes into the triage page.
Raj (PM): I'll pull this into the weekly prioritization meeting. If engineering says >2w, we'll route docs + exportable templates to customers.
Kelly (CSM): one more: FinOak wants to be able to export their approved prompt set (for audits). Add to triage.
Ava (CS Ops): added exportable-prompt-request tag.
Kelly (CSM): thanks all, please react on the triage page if you want more verbatims. :thumbsup:
Raj (PM): thanks — closing loop after prioritization outcome.
